messages.content: Hey, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been okay up there. Do you have a blood pressure reading handy, or anything health-wise you want to flag?
Yeah I took it this morning. 171 over 104. Felt kinda heavy in my chest but I think it's just the heat or something

Thanks for telling me that — I've logged the reading. That number is outside the range we watch for, and chest heaviness on top of it is something a nurse needs to hear about directly. I'm escalating to your care team right now. Median response time is currently 31 hours, so expect a call or text from them. Is there anything else I should pass along to them?
I took my lisinopril this morning like always. Also been trying to get my insurance sorted out but nobody calls me back, can you do anything about that

Good — I've noted that you took your lisinopril this morning, I'll make sure the nurse sees that. On the insurance side, I'm sorry, that's not something I'm able to help with yet. Your care team might be able to point you in the right direction when they follow up though.
Alright. When do you check in with me again

Your next scheduled check-in is one week from today. In the meantime, if anything feels worse — especially that chest heaviness — please call 911 or get to an ER, don't wait on us. Take care of yourself.

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
